data.content_ref: inline:Defense-witness certificates as derived obligations: keep the grounded fixpoint byte-identical (determinism, polynomial cost, reinstatement untouched) and add a post-pass that, for each committed root labeled IN, extracts a finite defense tree — every attacker attacked by an IN node, recursively, with no infinite regress — from the fixpoint and stores it as a derived artifact under a program check. This converts the root-validity guarantee from 'the label says IN' to 'here is the exhibited winning strategy', giving argumentative_critic and judge a concrete, attackable object rather than a bare label.
